hook.name: SpawnGateHook
hook.description: A beforeInitialize-only gate hook that restricts pool initialization to pools pre-registered by a privileged factory address (set once by the deployer). Prevents unauthorized pre-initialization of Spawn launch pools at hostile prices. Static fee bounds (1%–10%) are enforced at registration time. No swap logic is present; swaps execute as standard Uniswap v4 static-fee pools.
